content.text: Companies in finance, commerce, platforms, and other industries hold various sensitive information across thousands or tens of thousands of databases. Naturally, the cloud, data warehouses, and various BI tools used by companies make the security architecture for managing these increasingly complex. QueryPie's DB Access Control (QueryPie DAC) plays a central role in strengthening security for accumulated sensitive information, simplifying access control and management, and ensuring security stability. We will explain how to safely manage vast amounts of sensitive information and data in a multi-cloud environment.
How to easily manage access control in a multi-cloud environment and diverse database usage environments
DB access control in complex environments such as MongoDB and Hadoop
Easy management and control of sensitive information that is difficult to manage in NoSQL (schema-free)
QueryPie DAC maximizes the stability of DB access control management. For detailed usage, please check [Ch.QueryPie: 3-Stage Side Kick]!
